questions: Should the plotted values be the square roots of the squared differences (i.e., absolute differences) or the raw differences before squaring and square root?
What should happen if N is larger than the length of the lists?
Are the lists guaranteed to be of equal length? If not, how should mismatched lengths be handled?
Should the plot have any specific labels, title, or formatting (e.g., x-axis representing index order or something else)?

What order should the plotted values be in? The clarification says 'in the order they appear in the list', but does that mean the original list order or the order of the N largest differences as selected?
If there are ties in absolute differences, how should the N largest be selected? For example, if multiple differences have the same absolute value, which ones are chosen?
Should the function handle non-numeric elements in the lists (e.g., strings, None) or assume all elements are numbers?
What should be plotted on the x-axis? The indices of the selected differences or just sequential integers (0,1,...,N-1)?
